maria.product: Heads-up — after the ACME pilot we need to rebalance the catalog onboarding lanes. Enterprise customers are asking for private/VPC-compatible models to be fast-tracked. Can we define criteria and rollout plan?
sam.eng: Agreed. Need concrete fast-track criteria. My initial thought: p95 latency target, quantization pass, and a minimal regression threshold.
jordan.eng-ml: We ran microbenchmarks last week. Falcon-lite-v2 8-bit: p95 ~120ms on 2x A10g, quality ~0.92 vs reference. So to hit <110ms we'd need kernel tweaks or batching changes.
anna.solutions: Two enterprise pilots said they'll pause integration unless they can pin a stable model for private deploys during migration. They want a documented pin policy.
maria.product: Proposal: create a "private-ready" lane. Requirements: 1) perf p95 <=110ms on our CI rig; 2) evaluation regression <1.5% on enterprise prompt set; 3) automated KV-cache compatibility check; 4) pin exceptions allowed with 90-day deprecation notice. Thoughts?
sam.eng: Feasible. Kernel optimizations + smarter auto-batching should get us close. Note: cost/unit may rise ~8% for the optimized path. Recommend a 5-customer canary before broad rollout.
jordan.eng-ml: For evals we should use an enterprise prompt set (~500 queries) and include fallbacks. Action: jesse to add nightly job to run this set and produce perf + quality deltas. Also need a synthetic KV cache test.
jesse.eng-ml: On it — I'll wire nightly. Example bench command I'm adding to CI: ```python run_bench.py --model falcon-lite-v2 --mode p95 --dataset enterprise_500.json --kv-check```
deploy-bot: deploy:nightly-bench started 4332110472
anna.solutions: On comms/legal: customers want explicit pin SLA. Legal proposes default model lifecycle: models are supported for 12 months, pin exceptions via addendum. Need product to propose template.
maria.product: Clear action items: (1) Eng (sam + jordan + jesse) prototype a "private-ready" checklist and a cost/perf tradeoff doc by EOD Fri. (2) Product (maria) + Solutions (anna) draft a pin-exception contract template and public-facing lifecycle FAQ. (3) Solutions to surface 3 enterprise customers for canary.
sam.eng: :thumbsup: I'll lead the eng checklist. Will post checklist in #eng-runtime and link here.
maria.product: Thanks — let's aim to surface initial bench numbers and customer canary list at next triage (Tue). If anyone hits blockers ping me directly.
